scope: High-risk contradictory evidence targeted checks. 11 counted records; preserve holds. Direct bulk API attempts failed; multiple PubMed page bodies inaccessible, alternative original publisher/PMC indexed excerpts used.

checks.findings: Multicentre randomized double-blind calcium preconception/early pregnancy prevention trial; abstract funding verified: UBC as Gates Foundation grantee, WHO/HRP, Argentine cooperation fund, Centre for Intervention Science in Maternal and Child Health. Sponsor role and full disclosures pending; no generalized inference against calcium adequacy or indicated care.
checks.verification_scope: Selected original article/abstract indexed passages; full-text systematic appraisal and independent correction search not completed

checks.findings: Randomized activity restriction for arrested preterm labor; abstract conclusion does not demonstrate prevention. Newly located corrigendum PMID 37973443; correction content not inspected. Add numerical and recommendation-specific hold until reconciled. No change to individualized clinician instructions.
checks.verification_scope: Selected original article/abstract indexed passages; full-text systematic appraisal and independent correction search not completed

checks.findings: EMPOWaR randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial in pregnant participants with obesity without diabetes. MRC/NIHR EME programme funding confirmed. No improved pregnancy outcomes in studied population; not evidence against indicated diabetes treatment. Sponsor role and complete disclosures unresolved.
checks.verification_scope: Selected original article/abstract indexed passages; full-text systematic appraisal and independent correction search not completed

checks.findings: OPPTIMUM randomized double-blind trial. MRC/NIHR EME programme with regional public contributions. Primary obstetric, neonatal and childhood outcomes not significantly improved; serious adverse events comparison imprecise. Compare indication-specific short cervix trials, not generalized progesterone advice. Same cohort as CS5-008.
checks.verification_scope: Selected original article/abstract indexed passages; full-text systematic appraisal and independent correction search not completed

checks.findings: OPPTIMUM HTA report same cohort as CS5-007, not independent replication. Funded by MRC and managed by NIHR. Neonatal composite OR 0.72 (0.44–1.17); no significant benefit/harm established for primary outcomes. Formal missing-data and multiplicity appraisal pending.

checks.findings: Netherlands Quadruple P open-label superiority trial, singleton short cervix subgroup. Nonprofit Stichting Stoptevroegbevallen support. Pessary superiority not established; subgroup <28-week birth RR 3.7 (1.1–12.9) for cervical length ≤25 mm, imprecise. Review subgroup multiplicity and author disclosures; no self-management guidance.

checks.findings: TOPS open-label trial in 544 singleton pregnancies with short cervix; primary preterm birth/fetal death outcome 45.5% vs 45.6%, RR 1.00 (0.83–1.20). Increased fetal or infant death signal; early stopping requires careful appraisal. NICHD grant support; staff involved in design, data collection, interpretation and report approval. Full disclosure and comparative population appraisal pending. Maintain safety hold.

checks.findings: Saccone 2017 randomized pessary trial identity confirmed, NCT02716909; comparative review includes same trial, not independent primary evidence. Full outcomes and funding not independently extracted in this check; compare population and concomitant progesterone with TOPS and Quadruple P.

checks.findings: Australian double-blind colic probiotic RCT. Charitable Georgina Menzies Maconachie Trust cash support, BioGaia supplied product/placebo; article declares suppliers/trust had no conduct, analysis or reporting role. Authors disclosed nutrition company advisory/honoraria relationships and unrelated product donations. Strain and feeding subgroup matter; no universal probiotic recommendation.

checks.findings: AFFIRM UK/Ireland stepped-wedge cluster trial. Scottish Chief Scientist Office, Tommy's and Sands funding confirmed. Correction notice identity confirmed; exact corrected table not independently extracted, so existing numeric hold retained. Package result cannot justify delaying assessment of reduced fetal movement.

checks.findings: Thai randomized double-blind moringa capsule trial: median day-three milk volume 73.5 vs 50 mL, p=0.19. Positive author framing cannot turn nonsignificant endpoint into proven efficacy. Earlier similar title PMID 33822798 flagged for version/cohort comparison, not counted independently. Full funding, sponsor and harms appraisal unresolved.
